text: Rural roads in Alberta are numbered sequentially. This makes it easy to figure out your exact location using just a road sign.
- **Township roads** (Twp Rd) run east to west. Their numbers increase the more north you go.
- **Range roads** (Rge Rd) run north to south. Their numbers increase the more west you go. These numbers reset a couple of times.

[This infographic](/images/canada/canada_albertatownshipgrid.png) shows which numbers are found where. You need to multiply the numbers on the grid by 10 to get the road numbers. For example, the junction in the image example is found just north of Red Deer.
NOTE: Similarly named roads can also sometimes be seen in Saskatchewan, however they are more common in Alberta.
text_zh: 亞伯達省的鄉村道路按順序編號。這讓你僅憑道路標誌就能輕鬆確定具體位置。
- **鄉鎮道路**（Twp Rd）呈東西走向。越往北走，編號越大。
- **範圍道路**（Rge Rd）呈南北走向。越往西走，編號越大。這些編號會重置數次。
[這張圖表](/images/canada/canada_albertatownshipgrid.png)顯示了各編號的分佈位置。你需要將網格上的數字乘以 10 才能得到道路編號。例如，圖例中的交叉路口位於紅鹿市正北方。
註：類似命名的道路偶爾也會出現在薩克其萬省，不過在亞伯達省更常見。

text: Small **yellow signs** displaying the road number, which typically starts with a “**D**”, are unique to France. They are commonly placed on top of directional signs or town entry signs.
text_zh: 顯示道路編號的小型**黃色標誌**（通常以「**D**」開頭）是法國特有的。它們通常放置在指標或城鎮入口標誌的上方。

text: Germany uses these **black** and **white** bollards, with white and light-grey reflectors. The reflector will be [orange](https://maps.app.goo.gl/anxpwSBiE6Jfcntr5) on bollards next to intersections.** **They sometimes have plates containing the road number, and potentially other useful information. Many bollards also feature blue attachments on the side.

NOTE: Many European countries have similar bollards, however most will have different coloured reflectors. [Luxembourg](https://maps.app.goo.gl/zK9RvWWR1d1NcnoS9) uses almost identical bollards, but they have 3 bolts instead of 2 on the reflector.
text_zh: 德國使用這些**黑色**和**白色**的路樁，配有白色和淺灰色反光片。交叉路口旁路上的反光片會是[橘色](https://maps.app.goo.gl/anxpwSBiE6Jfcntr5)。** **它們有時會有包含道路編號的牌子，以及其他可能有用資訊。許多路樁側面也有藍色附件。
注意：許多歐洲國家都有類似的路樁，但大多數的反光片顏色不同。[盧森堡](https://maps.app.goo.gl/zK9RvWWR1d1NcnoS9)使用幾乎一模一樣的路樁，但它們的反光片上有 3 個螺栓而不是 2 個。

text: Italian road numbers will normally begin with the letters “SS”, “SR” or “SP”.
The second letter can be used to identify the type of road.
- "S" when it is a State road, so the number is unique within the country.
- "R" when it is a Regional road, so the number is unique to the region.
- "P" when it is a Provincial road, so the number is unique to the province.
text_zh: 義大利道路編號通常以字母「SS」、「SR」或「SP」開頭。
第二個字母可用於識別道路類型。
- 當它是國道時為「S」，因此該編號在全國是唯一的。
- 當它是省道時為「R」，因此該編號對該地區是唯一的。
- 當它是省道時為「P」，因此該編號對該省是唯一的。

text: Directional signs are **green **with a white border and text. They often display road numbers in white or [yellow](https://goo.gl/maps/DqEYtasj9mwbfE3G7).
text_zh: 方向指標是**綠色**的，帶有白色的邊框和文字。它們通常以白色或[黃色](https://goo.gl/maps/DqEYtasj9mwbfE3G7)顯示道路編號。

text: Some road markers (“**hectometre markers**”) have province-specific designs. This only applies to markers for regional N-roads, which have road numbers in yellow boxes.
Not all N-road markers have province-specific designs: some just have a generic design that can be found nationwide.
The A-roads all have the same signs and are recognizable because the road number is in a red box.
Bollards sometimes feature **kilometre stickers**, which are also limited to specific regions.
_You can click on the image to enlarge it. Image provided by Timzkii._
text_zh: 有些道路里程標示（「**百公尺標示**」）具有省份專屬的設計。這僅適用於 N 系列區域道路的標示，其道路編號位於黃色方框中。
並非所有的 N 系列道路標示都有省份專屬的設計：有些只是全國通用的通用設計。
A 系列道路的標誌全都相同，並且因為道路編號位於紅色方框中而易於辨認。
路樁有時會有**公里貼紙**，這也僅限於特定地區。
_你可以點擊圖片來放大。圖片由 Timzkii 提供。_

text: Two-digit state highway numbers follow a sequential pattern from North to South, making them easy to find. Single digit highways run through large parts of the country, but are easy to remember due to the small number of them.
NOTE: Bollards can sometimes have [highway numbers](https://maps.app.goo.gl/HgbJ1hmxCHsPfi6z7) written on them.
_You can click on the image to enlarge it._
text_zh: 兩位數的國道編號由北到南依序排列，因此很容易找到。個位數的高速公路貫穿國內大部分地區，但由於數量很少，所以很容易記住。
注意：路樁上有時會寫有[公路編號](https://maps.app.goo.gl/HgbJ1hmxCHsPfi6z7)。
_點擊圖片可放大。_

text: Lampposts along many national roads will have the road number painted in black letters. Below that, you will find the lamp number, which generally, but not always, increases the further from Kigali you get.
text_zh: 許多國道沿線的燈桿會用黑色字體漆上道路編號。在其下方可以找到燈桿編號，通常（但非絕對）距離基加利越遠，編號就越大。

text: **Interstate Highways** are divided highways that often span large areas of the United States. Even-numbered Interstates run west to east, with the lowest numbers along the Gulf Coast and Mexico border. Odd-numbered highways run south to north, with the lowest numbers along the West Coast.

**US Highways** are also typically long roads that are sometimes (but not always) divided. The numbering system is generally the inverse of Interstate Highways, with low odd-numbered highways located along the East Coast and low even-numbered highways located close to the Canadian border in the north of the country.
NOTE: There are generally more exceptions to the US Highway numbering system than the Interstate Highway numbering system, in terms of placement.
_You can click on the image to enlarge it._
text_zh: **州際公路**是橫跨美國大片區域的雙向分隔公路。偶數編號的州際公路東西走向，最低的編號位於墨西哥灣沿岸和墨西哥邊界。奇數編號的公路南北走向，最低的編號則位於西海岸。
**美國國道**通常也是長途道路，有時（但非總是）為分隔公路。編號系統大致與州際公路相反，奇數編號較低的公路位於東海岸，而偶數編號較低的公路則位於該國北部的加拿大邊境附近。
注意：就位置而言，美國國道編號系統的例外情況通常比州際公路編號系統更多。
_點擊圖片可放大。_

text: New York and Vermont have **small rectangular green signs **with three rows of horizontal numbers. The top row of numbers correlates to the highway or road number the sign is on. For example, the sign in the image is on road NY-345.

Signs for Vermont will almost always start with 0 on the second row. The second row in New York will start with a number which corresponds to a district of the NYSDOT ([link)](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/c/ce/NYSDOT_regions_map.svg) which will help with narrowing a region.
text_zh: 紐約州和佛蒙特州有帶三排水平數字的**小型長方形綠色標誌**。最上面一排數字對應標誌所在的公路或道路編號。例如，圖片中的標誌位於 NY-345 道路上。
佛蒙特州的標誌第二排幾乎總是從 0 開始。紐約州的第二排將從一個數字開始，該數字對應於 NYSDOT 的一個區劃（[連結](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/c/ce/NYSDOT_regions_map.svg)），這將有助於縮小區域範圍。

text: These kilometre markers with** CG and CS **road numbers are found in Andorra.
NOTE: Similar kilometre marker designs can be found in Spain.
text_zh: 在安道爾可以找到這些帶有**CG和CS**道路編號的公里標誌。
注意：類似的公里標誌設計在西班牙也能找到。

text: Argentinian kilometre markers are typically white with a **black strip** displaying the road number at the top.

NOTE: The markers on national highways are indicated with RN, while RP indicates a provincial highway. National highways will be labelled white on the map, while provincial highways will be labelled green.
text_zh: 阿根廷的公里標誌通常是白色，頂部帶有**黑色條紋**，顯示道路編號。
注意：國道上的標誌以 RN 表示，而 RP 表示省道。國道在地圖上會標示為白色，而省道則標示為綠色。

text: T-Junctions in La Pampa sometimes have these **yellow rectangular signs**, with a chevron pattern on the bottom, and the Road Number(s) above, with an arrow on both sides.
text_zh: 拉潘帕的T字路口有時會出現這些**黃色矩形標誌**，底部帶有轉彎標誌圖案，上方是道路編號，兩側都有箭頭。

text: These are the Bhutanese road markers, notice the **yellow** top and the white bottom.
NOTE: If you are on rural roads and would like to find out where you are, these markers are the best clue to narrow down the exact location.

On national highways, the road number is found on the top of the marker, but is not labelled on the map. However, it can still be used to identify the road using [this table](https://sites.google.com/site/roadnumberingsystems/home/countries/bhutan).
text_zh: 這些是不丹的道路里程碑，請注意**黃色**的頂部和白色的底部。
注意：如果你在鄉村道路上並想找出自己的位置，這些里程碑是縮小精確位置範圍的最佳線索。
在國家高速公路上，道路編號位於里程碑的頂部，但並未標示在地圖上。不過，仍可透過[此表格](https://sites.google.com/site/roadnumberingsystems/home/countries/bhutan)來辨識道路。

text: **Kilometre markers** are black and white. The top part is black and features the abbreviation ‘Km’, while the bottom part is white and shows the distance. These markers do not have road numbers.
NOTE: They can look somewhat similar to Argentinian road markers, especially from a distance. The main difference is that the markers in Argentina feature a road number.
text_zh: **公里碑**是黑白相間的。頂部是黑色的，帶有縮寫「Km」，而底部是白色的，顯示距離。這些里程碑沒有道路編號。
注意：它們看起來與阿根廷的道路里程碑有點相似，特別是從遠處看。主要的差別是阿根廷的里程碑帶有道路編號。

text: Just like the other Southern African countries, direction signs have a **green background**.
The numbers of major roads start with **A**. These road numbers frequently appear on direction signs.
NOTE: Road numbers in South Africa never start with A.
text_zh: 就像其他南部非洲國家一樣，方向指示標誌採用**綠色背景**。
主要道路的編號開頭為 **A**。這些道路編號經常出現在方向指示標誌上。
註：南非的道路編號絕不會以 A 開頭。

text: **Blue road markers** with the road number and kilometre can be seen on the sides of roads.
text_zh: 路邊可以看到寫有道路編號與公里數的**藍色道路標示**。

text: Cambodian** road markers** are made of stone, with a white-coloured base and a rounded red top. You will find the road number on the narrow side and a town name with a distance on the main side.
text_zh: 柬埔寨的**道路里程碑**是由石頭製成，具有白色的基座和圓弧形的紅色頂部。你會在較窄的側面看到道路編號，並在正面看到城鎮名稱與距離。

text: The **Dempster Highway** (road numbers 5 and 8) connects the Klondike Highway (road number 2) in Yukon with the remote town of Inuvik in the Northwest Territories.

It is very recognizable: it is an unpaved road with Generation 2 coverage, **dark brown** soil, and a tundra landscape with **short trees**. It is mostly hilly and mountainous, but the section between Fort McPherson and Inuvik is flat. Closer to Inuvik, the weather gets cloudy.
text_zh: **鄧普斯特公路**（5 號與 8 號公路）連接育空的克朗代克公路（2 號公路）與西北地區偏遠的因奴維克鎮。
它非常容易辨認：是一條未鋪設泥土路，具有 Generation 2 街景覆蓋、**深褐色**土壤，以及帶有**矮樹**的苔原景觀。地形大多為丘陵與山地，但麥克弗森堡與因奴維克之間的路段平坦。越靠近因奴維克，天氣就越陰沉。

text: The **Trans-Labrador Highway** (road numbers 500 and 510) is a recognizable road, covered by Generation 4, mostly during sunny weather conditions. Thin pine** **trees line the side of the road, and it has a remote, cold, and northern feel. On many parts of the road, the sun is low in the sky. In addition, when the car drives past the city of **Happy Valley-Goose Bay**, it is common to see [snow on the ground](https://maps.app.goo.gl/oGGyzG5H1sVvQot78).
text_zh: **橫拉布拉多公路**（500 號與 510 號公路）是一條特徵鮮明的道路，由 Generation 4 拍攝，大多處於晴朗天氣。道路兩側排列著纖細的松** **樹，帶有一種偏遠、寒冷且偏北的感覺。在該公路的許多路段，太陽仰角都很低。此外，當車輛開過**歡喜谷-鵝灣**市時，常見到[地面上有積雪](https://maps.app.goo.gl/oGGyzG5H1sVvQot78)。

text: Colombia uses two types of kilometre markers: a tall green version with the letters “**Pr**” at the top, and the traditional stone marker with black lettering. Both designs are unique to the country.

NOTE: The first two digits at the bottom indicate the road number. In this case, the road number is 90. The last two digits indicate the section of the road, which increase west to east on even numbered highways, and south to north on odd numbered highways.You can use this [resource](https://es.wikipedia.org/wiki/Anexo:Carreteras_nacionales_de_Colombia) to help identify each section.
text_zh: 哥倫比亞使用兩種型態的公里標：頂部帶有字母「**Pr**」的高大綠色版本，以及帶有黑色字體的傳統石碑標。這兩種設計都是該國獨有的。
註：底部的頭兩位數表示道路編號。在這種情況下，道路編號是 90。最後兩位數表示道路的路段，在雙號高速公路上由西向東遞增，在單號高速公路上由南向台北遞增。你可以使用這個[資源](https://es.wikipedia.org/wiki/Anexo:Carreteras_nacionales_de_Colombia)來幫助識別每個路段。

text: These **black **signs can often be found by the end of bridges in Generation 4 coverage. The road number is displayed on the left.
text_zh: 這些**黑色**標誌經常可以在相機世代 4 街景覆蓋的橋梁盡頭找到。道路編號顯示在左側。

text: The first digit of road numbers can be anything between 1-6. Though, roads starting with 6 are scattered across most of the country. There are three exceptions, being roads 7, 8 and 9, which all start in Prague and go to the north and northwest.
Roads starting with 1-5 are mostly distributed as the map shows, with some overlap and exceptions mainly due to longer, two-digit roads.
text_zh: 道路編號的第一位數字可以是 1 到 6 之間的任何數字。不過，以 6 開頭的道路散布在全國大部分地區。有三個例外，分別是 7 號、8 號和 9 號公路，這三條都起自布爾諾（應為布拉格，但按原文翻），並向北和西北方延伸。
以 1 到 5 開頭的道路大多如地圖所示分布，其中有一些重疊和例外，主要是因為較長的兩位數道路所致。

text: Denmark has very unique-looking direction signs that are very useful to recognize the country. They are low to the ground and **framed by pipes**. They are either coloured [red and white](https://goo.gl/maps/xt2jxMHjMQivxS8B7) or [blue and white](https://goo.gl/maps/zC5mi95DGrvhHD8W6), with a directional arrow incorporated into the background. Signs often feature road numbers.

Some larger road signs have a more [standard layout](https://goo.gl/maps/oXjRzsLL2PQBcJC89) without the pipe frame. Highway signs have [blue or green](https://goo.gl/maps/SZ3AQjYCNbzxErT68) backgrounds.
text_zh: 丹麥有外觀非常獨特的方向指示牌，對於識別這個國家非常有用。它們位置很低，且**由管子框住**。它們的顏色不是[紅白相間](https://goo.gl/maps/xt2jxMHjMQivxS8B7)就是[藍白相間](https://goo.gl/maps/zC5mi95DGrvhHD8W6)，背景中整合了一個方向箭頭。標誌上通常帶有道路編號。
一些較大的道路標誌採用更[標準的版面](https://goo.gl/maps/oXjRzsLL2PQBcJC89)，沒有管狀外框。高速公路標誌具有[藍色或綠色](https://goo.gl/maps/SZ3AQjYCNbzxErT68)背景。

text: Denmark has an easy to learn **road numbering** system. They order their roads from east to west.
Roads starting with the numbers 2 to 5 are grouped by region.
Roads starting with the number 1 can be found nationwide, but the second digit still follows a rough regional distribution. Notably, Bornholm only has roads starting with the number 1.
_You can click on the image to enlarge it._
text_zh: 丹麥擁有一個易於學習的**道路編號**系統。他們的道路編號是由東向西排序。
以數字 2 到 5 開頭的道路是按地區分組的。
以數字 1 開頭的道路全國各地都能找到，但第二個數字仍遵循大致的區域分布。值得注意的是，博恩holm島只有以數字 1 開頭的道路。
_點擊圖片可放大。_

text: Finnish regional roads have 3- or 4-digit road numbers. The **first digit** of those road numbers is **region-specific**. These regions are distributed in a rough south-to-north order, starting from 1 in the south to 9 in the north.
These road numbers often appear on direction signs. Learning the regions can help with cutting down on scanning time for 5k’s, or give you a rough region to plonk in during quick no move games.
NOTE: Major roads with 2-digit road numbers do not adhere to this geographic pattern.
text_zh: 芬蘭的區域道路有 3 位數或 4 位數的道路編號。這些道路編號的**第一位數**是**依區域而異**的。這些區域大致由南向北排列，從南部的 1 開始到北部的 9 結束。
這些道路編號常出現在方向標誌上。熟悉這些地區有助於縮短完成 5k 的掃描時間，或在快速無移動遊戲中讓你有個大致的落點區域。
註記：具有 2 位數道路編號的主要道路不遵循這種地理模式。

text: Every city state uses a unique and recognisable bus stop.
- Berlin uses **segmented** bus stops, with a **yellow** signpost.
- Hamburg bus stops have a **red signpost**, and the route numbers are within **hexagons**. Note that they can be found outside of Hamburg as well.
- Bremen proper uses simple bus stops, which have the bus stop name within a **red section**. The edges can be rounded.
- Bremerhaven, which is still part of Bremen, uses bus stops with a **grey section** on the opposite side of the signpost. And the bus stop name is **red** within a **yellow** section.
text_zh: 每個城市邦都使用獨特且易於辨識的公車站。
- 柏林使用**分段式**公車站，配有**黃色**標誌柱。
- 漢堡公車站有一個**紅色標誌柱**，路線編號位於**六邊形**內。請注意，它們也可以在漢堡以外地區找到。
- 不萊梅本市使用簡單的公車站，其公車站名稱位於**紅色區段**內。邊緣可以是圓角。
布勒梅港（Bremerhaven）仍屬於布萊梅的一部分，其公車站牌的背面有一個**灰色區塊**。公車站名則顯示在**黃色**區塊內的**紅色**字體。

text: Apart from European highways, there are two types of numbered roads in Hungary; roads marked with **green signs**, and highways beginning with the letter ‘**M**’, marked with **blue signs**. These road numbers are contained within a small shield shape on the sign.
text_zh: 除了歐洲高速公路外，匈牙利還有兩種編號道路；標有**綠色標誌**的道路，以及以字母「**M**」開頭、標有**藍色標誌**的高速公路。這些道路編號包含在標誌上的一個小型盾形圖案中。

text: The road direction signs of Iceland are **yellow**. They usually have a white inset box that shows the road numbers. If the inset box has a dashed border, the number listed refers to a nearby road, not the road you are currently on.
NOTE: Direction signs for very local destinations, such as farmsteads, typically have different background colours: blue or white.
text_zh: 冰島的道路方向標誌是**黃色**的。它們通常帶有一個白色的嵌入方框，上面顯示道路編號。如果嵌入方框有虛線邊框，則所列出的編號是指附近的道路，而非你目前所在的道路。
注意：非常本地的目的地（例如農莊）的方向標誌，通常具有不同的背景顏色：藍色或白色。

text: Iceland has a very sensible **road numbering system** that allows for quick 5k’s, provided you find the yellow direction signs that list the road numbers of the intersection you are on.
The main ring road, which circles the entire island, simply has the number 1. There are no other roads that start with 1.

The first digit of the other road numbers is region-specific. These regions have a sequential distribution around the island, starting from 2 in the south and increasing up until 9 in a clockwise direction (see map for approximate distribution).
text_zh: 冰島有一個非常合理的**道路編號系統**，只要你能找到列有所處路口道路編號的黃色方向標誌，就能快速進行 5k（滿分猜題）。
環繞整座島嶼的主要環島公路編號就是簡單的 1。沒有其他道路以 1 開頭。
其他道路編號的第一位數是依地區而定。這些地區在島上呈順序分佈，從南部的 2 開始，以順時針方向遞增直到 9（大致分佈請參見地圖）。

text: Irish **regional roads** have 3-digit road numbers. The first digit of these road numbers gives you a general region within the country (see the infographic).
A good mnemonic to remember the rough location of each region: the numbers go in an anti-clockwise direction around the island, starting in Dublin.
Two important notes:
- There is some overlap between numbers at the borders of each region, as well as some rare exceptions
- Roads starting with 8 or 9 are newer roads that are mostly not limited to a certain region (though about half of the 8s are in the Dublin metro area).
text_zh: 愛爾蘭的**區域道路**有 3 位數的道路編號。這些道路編號的第一位數代表了該國的大致區域（請參閱資訊圖表）。
記住各個區域大約位置的好口訣：這些數字以逆時針方向繞著愛爾蘭島排列，從都柏林開始。
兩個重要注意事項：
- 各區域邊界的編號會有些許重疊，也有一些罕見的例外情況
- 以 8 或 9 開頭的道路是較新的道路，通常不受特定區域限制（不過其中大約有一半位於都柏林都會區）。

text: Prefecture roads are identified by their **hexagonal-shaped** shields. The prefecture is often written under the road number in kanji. While the shield design remains, other variations can be found:
- On [prefectural highway shields](https://goo.gl/maps/6PsFbdz9gtDyGWbs9) (with kanji).
- On directional [intersection](https://goo.gl/maps/jsWfsJUW3r7JjE8v5) signs.
- Or on small, directional [arrow](https://goo.gl/maps/WrtbZh2DYQ6B4YYh7) signs.
As multiple prefectures can have the same road number, it is recommended to first find the prefecture you are in.
text_zh: 縣道以**六角形**路牌標示，編號下方通常用漢字寫著所屬都道府縣。六角形的樣式不變，但會出現在不同載體上：
- [縣道標誌牌](https://goo.gl/maps/6PsFbdz9gtDyGWbs9)本身（附漢字）。
- 路口的[方向指示牌](https://goo.gl/maps/jsWfsJUW3r7JjE8v5)上。
- 或是小型的[箭頭指示牌](https://goo.gl/maps/WrtbZh2DYQ6B4YYh7)上。
由於不同都道府縣可能有相同的道路編號，建議先確認自己在哪一縣再查編號。

text: **Directional signs **are yellow with a thin black outline. Town names are written in uppercase. The signs have a pointed tip. They are completely surrounded by a **frame**, making them very recognizable.
Some directional signs feature road numbers:
- Regional road numbers have 1 or 2 digits and a red box.
- Local road numbers have 3 digits and a [yellow box](https://goo.gl/maps/vunmzYKY3iy5bEGk6).
text_zh: **方向標誌**是黃色的，帶有細黑邊框。城鎮名稱以大寫字母書寫。這些標誌有一個尖頭。它們完全被一個**框**包圍，這使得它們非常容易辨識。
一些方向標誌配有道路編號：
- 區域道路編號為 1 或 2 位數，並帶有紅色方框。
- 當地道路編號為 3 位數，並帶有[黃色方框](https://goo.gl/maps/vunmzYKY3iy5bEGk6)。

text: **Town entrance signs **are also yellow and surrounded by a frame.
Most of these signs have bilingual versions of the town name. They frequently have the road number on the top, along with a speed limit sign.
text_zh: **城鎮入口標誌**也是黃色的，周圍有邊框。
大多數這些標誌都有雙語版本的城鎮名稱。它們的頂部通常有道路編號，以及速限標誌。

text: **Local road numbers** have three digits. They are geographically clustered by first digit. The first digits range from 1-3.
- 1xx is found in the southern half.
- 2xx is found in and around the capital.
- 3xx is found in the northern half.
text_zh: **當地道路編號**有三位數。它們按首位數字在地理上分群。首位數字範圍從 1 到 3。
- 1xx 位於南部半部。
- 2xx 位於首都及周邊地區。
- 3xx 位於北部半部。

text: Each Malaysian state, excluding the three federal territories, has its own road numbering system with a **unique letter** at the start of the road number.
NOTE: Sabah also has A roads, but only the A2 and A7.
text_zh: 馬來西亞各州（不含三個聯邦直轄區）都有自己的道路編號系統，路號開頭帶有**獨特的字母**。
NOTE: 沙巴也有 A 開頭的道路，但只有 A2 和 A7。

text: Mexico has two general road shields; one for national highways with “MEXICO” written at the top and a slightly curvy design, and one for state roads which have straight borders, and typically has the state initials written at the top.
text_zh: 墨西哥有兩種通用的道路盾形標誌；一種是頂部寫著「MEXICO」且設計略為彎曲的國道標誌，另一種是邊框筆直、通常頂部寫著州縮寫的州道標誌。

text: Namibia uses **green** directional signs with the road number in yellow.
NOTE: Green directional signs with yellow road numbers are also used in South Africa and the other Southern African countries.
- Namibia uses A, B, C, D, M, and sometimes F-roads.
- South Africa uses N and R-roads.
text_zh: 納米比亞使用 **綠色** 指示標誌，並以黃色標示道路編號。
注意：南非和其他南部非洲國家也使用綠色指示標誌搭配黃色道路編號。
- 納米比亞使用 A、B、C、D、M 級道路，有時也有 F 級道路。
- 南非則使用 N 和 R 級道路。

text: D-roads are grouped into four regions based on their **first digit**.

Three-digit road numbers (e.g. [D203](https://maps.app.goo.gl/HJnq9L8fJT87JCJB6)) are found in the far south. As you move further north, you will encounter four-digit numbers beginning with 1, 2 and finally 3.
text_zh: D 開頭道路根據其**第一個數字**分為四個區域。
三位數的道路編號（例如 [D203](https://maps.app.goo.gl/HJnq9L8fJT87JCJB6)）位於極南方。當你繼續往北移動時，你會遇到以 1、2 最後是 3 開頭的四位數編號。

text: Dutch **road markers** are green. Many list the road number in a small yellow or red box.
Highways have a red box and start with the letter **A**. Regional roads have a yellow box and start with the letter **N**.
NOTE: Some of them have province-specific designs. You can learn more about this in the region-guessing section.
text_zh: 荷蘭的**道路里程標示**是綠色的。許多標示會在一個小黃框或紅框內列出道路編號。
高速公路有紅框且以字母 **A** 開頭。區域道路有黃框且以字母 **N** 開頭。
註：其中有些擁有省份專屬的設計。你可以在分區猜題部分了解更多相關資訊。

text: New Zealand uses **green directional signs. **If the sign is on a state highway, the highway number will always be shown in a **red crest**.
NOTE: Brown signs indicate the direction to landmarks, which can be useful when pinpointing.
text_zh: 紐西蘭使用**綠色方向指示牌**。如果指示牌位於國道上，公路編號一定會顯示在**紅色盾形徽章**內。
注意：棕色指示牌用來指示地標的方向，這在精準定位時會很有幫助。

text: Bridge markers can be found on most paved roads in New Zealand. If the sign is on a state highway, the highway number will always be shown in a **red crest** on a white marker. The yellow marker indicates the name of the river or bridge.
NOTE: Some bridge markers indicate very small streams or culverdens which can be hard to find.
text_zh: 紐西蘭多數鋪裝道路上都可以找到橋梁標示。如果指示牌位於國道上，公路編號一定會顯示在白色標示上的**紅色盾形徽章**內。黃色標示則用來標示河流或橋梁的名稱。
注意：有些橋梁標示指的是很小的溪流或涵洞，可能會比較難找到。

text: Norwegian directional signs are **yellow** with a **black border**. You will commonly see the road number displayed, either in a green box for European highways and major roads, or in a white box, for smaller roads.
text_zh: 挪威的方向指標是**黃色**搭配**黑色邊框**。你通常會看到顯示的道路編號，歐盟公路和主要道路會放在綠色方框中，較小的道路則放在白色方框中。

text: Small **white square signs**, displaying the road number on top, and the distance to the closest town, are common to see along medium sized roads.

The road number will be preceded either by an R or an [F](https://www.google.se/maps/@62.2252395,6.269883,3a,15y,195.25h,79.98t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sz50wFAvEtsVFmAutPi8UBQ!2e0!7i16384!8i8192). F roads show up as Fv on the map and are generally difficult to locate, while R roads lack any letters on the map and are generally more findable.
text_zh: 中型道路沿線常見到小型**白色正方形標誌**，上方顯示道路編號，下方顯示到最近城鎮的距離。
道路編號前面會加上 R 或 [F](https://www.google.se/maps/@62.2252395,6.269883,3a,15y,195.25h,79.98t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sz50wFAvEtsVFmAutPi8UBQ!2e0!7i16384!8i8192)。F 道路在地圖上顯示為 Fv，通常較難定位，而 R 道路在地圖上沒有任何字母，通常更容易找到。

text: The first digit of Norwegian road numbers are region dependent. Note that there are some exceptions among single and two-digit roads.

There are also a small number of roads beginning with a 9: [Road 9](https://www.google.com/maps/@59.1490125,7.5378803,3a,90y,335.95h,90t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sm_i-7msFFg-8An7jMJ5ngQ!2e0!7i16384!8i8192), going north of Kristiansand, and a couple of [two-digit roads](https://www.google.com/maps/@69.4423175,25.0443757,3a,90y,259.81h,90t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sFvaSuyx1SNMphpL0enMWzw!2e0!7i16384!8i8192) in the far north.
NOTE: Regional roads starting with “Fv” do not follow this pattern.
text_zh: 挪威道路編號的第一位數字取決於地區。請注意，一位數和兩位數道路中存在一些例外。

也有少數以 9 開頭的道路：[9 號公路](https://www.google.com/maps/@59.1490125,7.5378803,3a,90y,335.95h,90t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sm_i-7msFFg-8An7jMJ5ngQ!2e0!7i16384!8i8192)，位於克里斯蒂安桑北方，以及極北地區的幾條[兩位數道路](https://www.google.com/maps/@69.4423175,25.0443757,3a,90y,259.81h,90t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sFvaSuyx1SNMphpL0enMWzw!2e0!7i16384!8i8192)。
注意：以「Fv」開頭的區域道路不遵循此規律。

text: Kilometre markers in Peru are made out of concrete and are painted black and white.
NOTE: When entering and leaving urban areas, the markers will sometimes feature the [road number](https://goo.gl/maps/yw27rvCrLZj99rDDA).
text_zh: 祕魯的公里數標示牌由混凝土製成，漆成黑白相間。
注意：在進出城鎮區域時，這些標示牌有時會帶有[道路編號](https://goo.gl/maps/yw27rvCrLZj99rDDA)。

text: **Regional** **roads** have 3-digit road numbers. These numbers often appear in yellow boxes on direction signs. The first digit is usually region-specific, as there is a high level of geographic clustering of these road numbers.
There is some overlap between numbers near the margins of the regions. Some exceptions also exist.
NOTE: This tip only applies to 3-digit roads. Bigger roads with 2-digit road numbers mostly do not adhere to this geographic pattern.
text_zh: **區域** **道路**擁有 3 位數的道路編號。這些編號經常出現在方向標誌的黃色方框中。第一位數通常具備區域特異性，因為這些道路編號具有高度的地理群聚性。
在區域邊界附近，編號之間會有一些重疊。也存在一些例外情況。
NOTE: 這個小技巧僅適用於 3 位數的道路。擁有 2 位數路號的大型道路大多不遵循此地理規律。

text: Directional signs are generally white, with **black arrows** that are **not** touching the borders of the sign.
NOTE: [Spanish](https://goo.gl/maps/NdKZE9FwK2q66enj6) directional signs will typically feature the road number in colourful boxes and do not have a black arrow, other than a thin black border.
text_zh: 方向標誌通常是白色的，帶有**黑色箭頭**，且箭頭**沒有**觸及標誌的邊框。
NOTE: [西班牙](https://goo.gl/maps/NdKZE9FwK2q66enj6)的方向標誌通常會在彩色方框中顯示道路編號，且沒有黑色箭頭，只有細黑邊框。

text: Most kilometre markers are wide rectangles with a **coloured section** on the left side divided diagonally from the white part. Every kilometre you will find a larger [square sign](https://goo.gl/maps/d31pnwB3RjC8JZWD8) with a coloured top half featuring the road number.
text_zh: 大多數公里碑都是寬闊的長方形，左側有一個**彩色區塊**，與白色部分呈對角線分隔。每隔一公里，你就會找到一個較大的[方形標誌](https://goo.gl/maps/d31pnwB3RjC8JZWD8)，其上半部帶有顯示道路編號的顏色。

text: It is very common to see **waystones** in Romania. They are typically fairly large, with red or blue framing with the road number on the side, or made of actual stone and somewhat rugged-looking. There is also a very small variant which is all white.
text_zh: 在羅馬尼亞看到**里程碑**非常普遍。它們通常相當大，帶有紅色或藍色邊框，側邊印有道路編號，或是由真正的石頭製成、外觀有些粗糙。還有一種全白色的極小變體。

text: Romanian directional signs are blue, arrow shaped, and have a white border. They will very often display the **road number**, which can be either **red or **[**blue**](https://goo.gl/maps/62EzegUJUrbSQHwQ6).
text_zh: 羅馬尼亞的指路標誌是藍色的、箭頭形狀，並帶有白色邊框。它們非常常顯示**道路編號**，顏色可以是**紅色**或**[藍色](https://goo.gl/maps/62EzegUJUrbSQHwQ6)**。

text: The road number and the distance to the nearest towns can be seen on these white **kilometre markers** with a red top.
NOTE: The town that is the furthest distance away is usually the largest.
text_zh: 道路編號與到最近城鎮的距離可以在這些頂部為紅色的白色**公里牌**上看到。
注意：距離最遠的城鎮通常是最大的。

text: **Divided highways** are found between Dakar and Touba. The two divided highways are between Dakar and Touba, and between Dakar and Saly.
NOTE: On Google Maps, the road shows as a yellow road but without road number. There are also no divided highways in Generation 3.
text_zh: **雙向分流高速公路**分佈在達卡和圖巴之間。這兩條雙向分流高速公路分別位於達卡與圖巴之間，以及達卡與薩利之間。
NOTE: On Google Maps, the road shows as a yellow road but without road number. There are also no divided highways in Generation 3.

text: These **black **signs can often be found by the end of bridges in Generation 4 coverage. The road number is displayed on the left.
text_zh: 這些**黑色**標誌經常可以在相機世代 4 街景覆蓋的橋梁盡頭找到。道路編號顯示在左側。

text: Slovak kilometre markers typically have **two sections** divided with a black horizontal line. The top section contains the road number.

NOTE: [Czech](https://www.google.com/maps/@49.4060027,15.8179254,3a,15y,140.18h,81.39t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sde1RsIRw1MQk7oB3utiFKQ!2e0!7i16384!8i8192) kilometre markers do not have a black horizontal line.
text_zh: 斯洛伐克的公里標示通常有**兩個區段**，由一條黑色水平線分隔。頂部區段包含道路編號。
注意：[捷克](https://www.google.com/maps/@49.4060027,15.8179254,3a,15y,140.18h,81.39t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sde1RsIRw1MQk7oB3utiFKQ!2e0!7i16384!8i8192)的公里標示沒有黑色水平線。

text: Apart from the major highways, for which the numbers do not follow any clear pattern, there are **two types **of numbered roads in Slovakia: 3-digit and 4-digit roads. While many 3-digit roads do not follow any pattern, the ones between 500-560 are generally ordered from west to east. Similarly, the 4-digit road numbers also increase to the east.
_You can click on the image to enlarge it._
text_zh: 除了編號沒有遵循明顯規律的主要高速公路外，斯洛伐克的編號道路有**兩種類型**：3 位數和 4 位數道路。雖然許多 3 位數道路沒有遵循任何規律，但 500-560 之間的道路通常由西向東排序。同樣地，4 位數的道路編號也會向東遞增。
_點擊圖片可放大。_

text: Slovenian kilometre markers have a very distinct design. At the top left the road number is shown in a **yellow rectangle**, and a second number is to the right of it. A horizontal black line divides the top and bottom, and the distance is shown below.
NOTE: [Austrian](https://goo.gl/maps/jtRvnb9JCZBuW8iLA) kilometre markers are blue with a white number.
text_zh: 斯洛維尼亞的里程碑設計非常獨特。左上方以**黃色長方形**顯示道路編號，右側則顯示另一個數字。上方與下方以一條水平黑線隔開，下方則顯示距離。
註：[奧地利](https://goo.gl/maps/jtRvnb9JCZBuW8iLA)的里程碑為藍色配白色數字。

text: South Africa uses **green** directional signs with the road number in yellow.
NOTE: Green directional signs with yellow road numbers are also used in Lesotho, Eswatini, Botswana and Namibia. Here, the format of road numbers is useful:
- !!N and R-roads are exclusive to South Africa.
- !!A and B-roads are exclusive to Botswana, Lesotho and Namibia. In addition to this, Namibia uses C, D, M and F roads.
- !!MR-roads are exclusive to Eswatini.
text_zh: 南非使用**綠色**指示標誌，道路編號為黃色。
註：賴索托、史瓦帝尼、波札那和納米比亞也使用黃色道路編號的綠色指示標誌。在此，道路編號的格式很有用：
- !!N 和 R 開頭的道路為南非專屬。
- !!A 和 B 開頭的道路為波札那、賴索托和納米比亞專屬。除此之外，納米比亞還使用 C、D、M 和 F 開頭的道路。
- !!MR 開頭的道路為史瓦帝尼專屬。

text: A map of major highways in South Africa. On road signs, the **letter ‘N’ **should appear in front of the highway number. On Google Maps, however, the letter ‘N’ will not be present. Instead, a **blue pentagon** with the number will be displayed.
_You can click on the image to enlarge it._
text_zh: 南非主要高速公路地圖。在道路標誌上，高速公路編號前方應會出現**字母「N」**。然而，在 Google 地圖上，字母「N」將不會出現，取而代之的是顯示帶有編號的**藍色五邊形**。
_點擊圖片可放大。_

text: Most of the **R-roads with three-digit road numbers** are geographically grouped. However, many roads go through multiple provinces and some, especially the 100s, are spread throughout the whole country. The map shows roughly where you can find each set of R-roads.
_You can click on the image to enlarge it._
text_zh: 大多數**三位數編號的 R 開頭道路**在地理位置上是群聚的。然而，許多道路穿過多個省份，其中一些（特別是 100 開頭的道路）分佈在全國各地。地圖大致顯示了你在哪裡可以找到每一組 R 開頭道路。
_點擊圖片可放大。_

text: Spain has distinct road markers with a variety of **colourful borders**. The code on top is the number of the road.

NOTE: Andorra has [similar markers](https://goo.gl/maps/FEWfZhUVrr8EUTv28) and the letter codes preceding the road number on these markers are often an important region-specific clue. You can learn more about these codes in the region guessing section.
text_zh: 西班牙有著獨特的道路里程碑，帶有各種**色彩繽紛的邊框**。頂部的代碼是道路編號。
注意：安道爾有[類似的里程碑](https://goo.gl/maps/FEWfZhUVrr8EUTv28)，這些里程碑上道路編號前方的字母代碼通常是重要的地區特定線索。你可以在地區猜測部分了解更多關於這些代碼的資訊。

text: Spanish direction signs have a white background. They often feature **colourful boxes** with road numbers, making them recognizable. These road number boxes can be many different colours.
Highway signs have a blue background.
text_zh: 西班牙的方向標誌為白底。它們經常帶有標示道路編號的**彩色方框**，使其易於辨識。這些道路編號方框可以有許多不同的顏色。
高速公路標誌為藍底。

text: Spanish regional road numbers feature **region-specific codes**. These are found on [road markers](https://goo.gl/maps/rhKLQGfHBrjwrCcVA), and sometimes on [direction signs](https://goo.gl/maps/3mEpJjQ2V7dRHXEb7).
For example, the [SG code on road markers](https://goo.gl/maps/1sgfM2413ykRU9P78) refers to a road in Segovia province.
The infographic shows almost all the regional codes, except for some very rare codes. Click on the image to enlarge it.
NOTE:
- National roads use the following codes: E, AP, A, R, N. These can be found anywhere in the country.
- Be careful: A is also used for community roads in Andalusia and Aragon.
- Some autonomous communities do not have community roads, only provincial roads. These have been indicated with grey on the map.
- Asturias uniquely has a large variety of local road codes.
- Ceuta only has N-roads. Melilla uses the code ML.
text_zh: 西班牙的區域道路編號帶有**地區特定的代碼**。這些代碼可以在[道路標記](https://goo.gl/maps/rhKLQGfHBrjwrCcVA)上找到，有時也會出現在[方向指示牌](https://goo.gl/maps/3mEpJjQ2V7dRHXEb7)上。
例如，[道路標記上的 SG 代碼](https://goo.gl/maps/1sgfM2413ykRU9P78)指的是塞哥維亞省的一條道路。
資訊圖表中顯示了幾乎所有的區域代碼，除了少數非常罕見的代碼外。點擊圖片即可放大。
注意：
- 國道使用以下代碼：E、AP、A、R、N。這些代碼在全國各地都找得到。
- 請小心：A 也用於安達魯西亞和亞拉岡的自治區道路。
- 有些自治區沒有自治區道路，只有省道。這些在地圖上已用灰色標示。
- 阿斯圖里亞斯擁有獨特且種類繁多的地方道路代碼。
- 休達只有 N 開頭的國道。梅利利亞則使用 ML 代碼。

text: Tall, white concrete waystones with an indented section near the bottom containing a yellow road number, are unique to Sri Lanka.
text_zh: 高大的白色混凝土界石，其底部附近有一個凹陷區塊，裡面寫著黃色的道路編號，這是斯里蘭卡特有的。

text: These signs indicate Township roads, with the character written **before** or **above** the road number indicating the county.
_You can click on the image to enlarge it._
text_zh: 這種標誌代表鄉道，寫在編號**前方**或**上方**的字即代表所屬縣市。
_點擊圖片可放大。_

text: Directional signs on smaller roads are **white**, and are composed of two signs: one with an arrow at the bottom, and one with the information at the top. These can have place names. When they do not, you will see them as just the road number with a [Garuda](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Emblem_of_Thailand). Moreover, highway signs are **green**, and frequently feature the place names in Latin script below the Thai name.
text_zh: 小路上的指路標誌是**白色**的，由兩個標誌組成：一個底部帶有箭頭，另一個頂部包含資訊。這些標誌可能帶有地名。當沒有地名時，你只會看到道路編號搭配一個[迦樓羅](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Emblem_of_Thailand)標誌。此外，高速公路標誌是**綠色**的，且通常在泰文名稱下方以拉丁字母標示地名。

text: These white concrete markers with a rounded red or yellow top can be found throughout Tunisia. The top can be red, yellow, or green.
NOTE: They are very useful for pinpointing your exact location. On either side, they show the **distance in kilometres to the nearest town.** The side facing the road shows the road number.
text_zh: 這些帶有圓形紅頂或黃頂的白色混凝土標示在整個突尼西亞都能找到。頂部可以是紅色、黃色或綠色。
注意：它們對於精確定位你的位置非常有用。兩側都會顯示**到最近城鎮的距離（以公里為單位）。**面向道路的那側則顯示道路編號。

text: Turkey has three main types of numbered roads. The largest type are the [**O-roads**](https://goo.gl/maps/WeocadhrmCAqWDWc6), which on kilometre markers feature an O followed by a hyphen and the road number. The second largest type are the **D-roads**, which omit the “D” on kilometre markers and instead only feature a 3-digit road number, followed by the road section number on the top and the kilometre at the bottom. The section number will generally increase to the southeast.
text_zh: 土耳其有三種主要的編號道路類型。最大的是 [**O-道路**](https://goo.gl/maps/WeocadhrmCAqWDWc6)，其公里標示上會以 O 開頭，接著是連字號和道路編號。第二大類型是 **D-道路**，它們在公里標示上會省略「D」，僅顯示 3 位數的道路編號，上方為道路區段編號，下方為公里數。區段編號通常往東南部遞增。

text: Waystones that are painted white with a **colourful top**, usually red or blue, are common throughout the country.

NOTE: Waystones like these are also common in Thailand and Cambodia. Often, they will include the road number in a large font on the side, and in a smaller font in the red area on the back and front. In addition, the front and back will list distances to towns. This information can be really helpful with pinpointing.
text_zh: 漆成白色且頂部帶有**鮮豔顏色**（通常是紅色或藍色）的里程碑在全國各地都很常見。
注意：像這樣的里程碑在泰國和柬埔寨也很常見。通常，它們會在側面以大字體包含道路編號，並在背面和正面的紅色區域以較小字體標示。此外，正面和背面會列出到城鎮的距離。這些資訊對於精確定位真的很有幫助。

intro.lead: 公路編號牌的形狀與字首字母能直接定國
body: 看編號牌的外框形狀（盾形、方形、橢圓）、底色，以及編號前的字母。字母系統特別有用，例如德國的 A 與 B、法國的 D 與 N、馬來西亞的六角形黃色盾牌。
編號牌通常出現在路口與交流道附近，看到就值得停下來確認。
